A '''vault''' built by the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] [[Species/Legends|species]] to store powerful weapons was located in [[the Tomb]], an ancient [[Prison/Legends|prison]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]]. Located in the [[Warlord's Deep]] region of the Tomb, the vault was cracked open by the [[Esh-kha]] [[Species/Legends|species]] after they were released in the [[invasion of Belsavis]], and after the Esh-kha began to use the weapons against [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] forces in the area, [[Specialist/Legends|Specialist]] [[Nattis]] of the [[Imperial Reclamation Service]] recruited Imperial forces to recover the weapons from the vault.<ref name="Found in Translation" />

==Behind the scenes==
The forbidden weapons vault appears as a location on Belsavis in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', and is the site of the Imperial mission "Found In Translation."<ref name="Found in Translation" />
